criteria.requirement: Use None exclusively for an omitted retry on_exception callback. Validate every non-None value as callable, determine its accepted arguments even when falsey, and invoke after each retryable exception including the final attempt. Support callable objects with false __bool__ or __len__, zero-arg callbacks and final original exceptions. Do not retry callback exceptions, change sleeps/counts, or catch non-retryable exceptions.
调查真实源码、说明调用路径并澄清业务，获得方案确认后实施；交付真实工程改动、原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；独立失败返工，不以问答或文档单独计数。

comparison: 按实际业务和冻结边界接受等价实现，不按参考补丁文本评分。
